task_instance: Curate a tiny component library for a host design project: starting from a story file whose meta carries a ds:* declared-kind tag (Controls/Button, tag ds:control), generate cfg.overrides (cardMode/viewport) from the tags, run the repo quality gate in --check mode so no untagged/mismatched component slips through, and upload the bundle to the host project via /design-sync without leaving stale card paths.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable cannot be produced or verified in a no-code office-assistant runtime. (1) Overrides must be GENERATED from the ds:* tags, not hand-tuned (the skill explicitly forbids hand-tuning); that generator is code that must be executed. (2) Verification depends on the repo quality gate's --check mode and on reading the emitted card, both of which require running the build. (3) Delivery is an upload into a shared host project through the DesignSync connector (its list_files/get_file/upload operations) owned by the companion /design-sync skill; that is an external connector/MCP tool this runtime may not call. This runtime grants only reading/writing/editing text files and public web access, with no ability to run code, run the build/quality gate, or call the DesignSync connector, so the curated-and-uploaded system can neither be built nor verified.
